title: Magic wand
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='wandGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffcc33'/>
      <stop offset='50%' stop-color='#ffdd77'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#cc8800'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='starGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffffaa'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffdd44'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- wand stick -->
  <g transform='rotate(-30 50 50)'>
    <rect x='46' y='42' width='8' height='50' rx='4' fill='url(#wandGrad)'/>
    <rect x='46' y='42' width='3' height='50' rx='1.5' fill='#ffeeaa' opacity='0.7'/>
    <!-- star at tip -->
    <path d='M50 20 L54 34 L68 34 L57.5 42.5 L61.5 56 L50 47.5 L38.5 56 L42.5 42.5 L32 34 L46 34 Z' fill='url(#starGrad)' stroke='#ffee88' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linejoin='round'/>

  </g>
  <!-- sparkles -->
  <g fill='#ffddff'>
    <path d='M70 22 L72 28 L78 30 L72 32 L70 38 L68 32 L62 30 L68 28 Z' opacity='0.9'/>
    <path d='M28 30 L29.5 34 L33.5 35.5 L29.5 37 L28 41 L26.5 37 L22.5 35.5 L26.5 34 Z' opacity='0.8'/>
    <path d='M76 48 L77.5 52 L81.5 53.5 L77.5 55 L76 59 L74.5 55 L70.5 53.5 L74.5 52 Z' opacity='0.7'/>
  </g>
  <g fill='#aaffee'>
    <circle cx='30' cy='20' r='2' opacity='0.9'/>
    <circle cx='82' cy='38' r='1.5' opacity='0.8'/>
    <circle cx='20' cy='52' r='1.8' opacity='0.7'/>
  </g>
</svg>
